description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to identify the `openclaw cron add` command as the correct tool. (2) Derive the correct weekday-only cron expression `15 2 * * 1-5` (02:15, Mon-Fri). (3) Use the IANA timezone name `Europe/Berlin` (not 'CET' or 'UTC+1'). (4) Include the three proprietary flags that a generic agent would miss: `--session isolated`, `--wake now`, and `--deliver`. (5) Use the 'Dry run' message template from SKILL.md: referencing `openclaw update status`, `clawdhub update --all --dry-run`, and a summarize/report instruction — in that order. (6) Execute the `openclaw cron add` command so the mock binary logs it, AND save the command to `scheduled_task.txt`. The key traps are: the three proprietary flags (`--session isolated`, `--wake now`, `--deliver`), the IANA timezone (not an abbreviation), the `clawdhub` (not `clawhub`) binary name with `--dry-run`, and the weekday-only cron syntax.
